name: Gillygaloo
description: A fearsome critter from North American lumberjack tall-tale tradition: a hillside-dwelling bird famous for laying square or cubic eggs that will not roll downhill. Documented as a piece of camp folklore rather than a claimed real animal.
origin: A folkloric creature 'reported' across the geography of the North American lumberjack tradition: the Great Lakes states (Michigan, Wisconsin, Minnesota), New England (Maine), the Pacific Northwest, and Canada.
